reviewed_by: Codex focused review for compact provider tool receipts
reason: The Core change sends compact receipts for completed retrievable tool results, preserves the first failure and explicit lookup excerpt, and retains current browser screenshots. Eight collected context-pruning tests cover receipt delivery, explicit read, failure detail, context avoidance and capacity; 44 chat routing and reasoning replay cases cover provider wire batches and screenshot attachment; ten tool-history memory cases cover checkpoints, cross-turn history, and retrieval access.
exclusions: No UI or native source changed. Frontend and browser layout tests do not inspect model-facing request payloads, so they are excluded. Unrelated backend tests and full suites are excluded. Real-Core/production browser acceptance will be reported separately from selected unit/integration tests.
